query:
UPDATE users
            SET email = $2,
                password_hash = NULL,
                first_name = $3,
                last_name = $4,
                pending_email = NULL,
                pending_email_requested_at = NULL,
                deleted_at = $5,
                deletion_scheduled_at = NULL,
                tokens_valid_after = NOW(),
                version = version + 1,
                updated_at = $6
            WHERE id = $1
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
              AND deletion_scheduled_at IS NOT NULL
              AND deletion_scheduled_at <= NOW()
